[SWS_PHM_01350] Switch Elementary Supervision Status from kFAILED to kEXPIRED
⌈
If the Elementary Supervision Status is kFAILED
AND if the Alive Supervision has a permanent failure, i.e. the counter for failed
Alive Supervision reference cycles exceeds failure tolerance failedReferenceCy-
clesTolerance, THEN the Platform Health Management shall change the El-
ementary Supervision Status to kEXPIRED and stop the corresponding super-
vision.
⌋
